summary: NixOS + home-manager configuration for the single host trantor, built from one flake. flake/ produces the outputs, hosts/trantor holds host-specific settings, modules/ holds the feature modules (with flags under modules/features/), packages/ holds custom derivations, and the Justfile is the task interface; scripts/dev/ carries the repo gates that `just lint` and `just check` run.

areas.purpose: Flake entry point: inputs and the nixosConfigurations, checks, devShells and apps outputs
areas.coverage: Outputs read at lines 161-208; input set not audited

areas.purpose: Flake helpers: nixos.nix (mkNixosOutputs, trantorDomains), checks.nix (parallel-eval checks and guards), per-system.nix, devshells.nix, apps.nix, lib.nix
areas.coverage: checks.nix and nixos.nix inspected in this session

areas.purpose: Host-specific configuration: default.nix, hardware.nix, networking.nix, services/, plus the notification and telegram integration files
areas.coverage: Directory listing only; file contents beyond default.nix not read here

areas.purpose: Feature modules grouped by domain (core, cli, dev, features, hardware, llm, media, monitoring, security, servers, system, user, ...); feature flags live under modules/features/ and gates in modules/user/nix-maid/apps/
areas.coverage: 170 directories counted; the first 20 groups were listed, the rest remain uninspected

areas.purpose: Custom overlays and per-package derivations, exposed through packages/overlay.nix as pkgs.neg.* (for example packages/dsh)
areas.coverage: Directory listing and the overlay entry point; individual packages not audited

areas.purpose: Shared Nix helpers (opts.nix, neg-helpers.nix) and eval-only unit tests (feature-flags-tests.nix, fzf-opts-tests.nix, ...) wired into the flake checks
areas.coverage: File listing; helper semantics not verified

areas.purpose: Userland configuration data consumed by modules (hyprland, quickshell, cli, gui, art, firmware, ...)
areas.coverage: First 14 entries listed; no content inspection

areas.purpose: Repo gates and helper scripts invoked by `just lint` / `just check` (markdown language policy, osh syntax, dsh session/statusline/worktree guards, hyprland variables)
areas.coverage: Listing only; individual gate semantics documented where they live

areas.purpose: Operational runbooks (runbook-*.md, index in runbook-index.md) and howtos; docs/AGENTS.md fixes the English-only policy
areas.coverage: Listing and the language policy; individual runbooks not read

areas.purpose: SOPS-encrypted secrets, consumed in Nix as <secret>.path with 0400/0600 modes; secrets/AGENTS.md governs access
areas.coverage: Directory and policy file only; contents are encrypted and were not opened

areas.purpose: Nix-side test fixtures referenced by flake checks (for example apparmor-enforce.nix)

Task interface: fmt (nix fmt), lint (statix, deadnix, guards, ruff/black, taplo, rustfmt, music selftest), check (nix flake check -L --option substitute false), deploy/switch, agent-switch, flag, flag-eval
areas.coverage: Recipes fmt, lint and check read; target list reviewed

areas.purpose: Repo-wide agent contract: language policy, minimal changes, substitute=false builds, switch discipline, commit style
areas.coverage: Read in full during this session

facts.claim: The flake exposes nixosConfigurations, checks, devShells and apps, generated per system
`just check` runs nix flake check with substitute false, and `just lint` runs the devshell gate set
A repo gate enforces the markdown language policy (no Cyrillic or CJK in *.md)
trantor's module domain set is restricted by trantorDomains in flake/nixos.nix
Agent switch requests are handed to a root-owned unit instead of passwordless nixos-rebuild

unknowns: The complete module-group list and per-group purpose (modules/ holds 170 directories; only the first 20 groups were listed)
Which files/ subtrees are generated versus hand-maintained
Behaviour of the appimage and apps domains, which trantorDomains excludes
No production or runtime verification is represented here: this map is a reading aid, not a test result
